Milestone 1.1.5: Create design report including initial analysis of potential energy, emissions, and cost savings and get documented feedback from potential industry partner. Design Optimization To identify a design which met these targets while meeting the constraint on a clean zoning region, we performed a parameter sweep using our computational model of the reactor. This involved randomizing both the reactor geometry and operating conditions within reasonable bounds to determine (1) which variables our objectives were principally sensitive to and (2) which designs, and operating conditions would prove optimal.
